title: Smoky Celeriac Bake
description: A hearty, comforting side dish with a smoky twist, perfect for the colder months. The sweetness of the celeriac pairs beautifully with the smoky flavor.
instructions: Peel and chop the celeriac into 1-inch cubes.
In a large bowl, toss the celeriac with the olive oil, garlic, salt, and black pepper until well coated.
Transfer the celeriac mixture to a baking dish and sprinkle with smoky paprika.
If using, sprinkle the zesty breadcrumbs on top of the celeriac.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the celeriac is tender and lightly browned.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
